post.description:
Create or update a user with a password hashed using the per-organization salt (v2).
Generates missing tenant orgSalt automatically. Sets user.hashVersion = 2.
This is a minimal demo endpoint; add email verification and stricter validations for production.

1.v2 (current): tenant.orgSalt (+ optional global pepper from env) concatenated with password, hashed using argon2id when available, then bcrypt, then scrypt as a fallback. New accounts use v2.

Inline notes on hashing scheme and migra.2: If tenant.orgSalt is missing (legacy tenants), it is auto-generated and persisted on-demand.

post.description: Authenticate a user by organization, email and password. Performs on-login migration from legacy hash to per-tenant orgSalt scheme.

Resets a user's password using the v2 scheme (tenant orgSalt + optional global pepper).
Auto-generates tenant orgSalt if missing (legacy tenant). DEMO ONLY – add token validation and throttling for production.

SECURITY & MIGRATION NOTES.0: This endpoint rehashes using v2 regardless of prior version; user.hashVersion is set to 2 on success.
SECURITY & MIGRATION NOTES.1: If tenant.orgSalt is missing, it is generated and persisted before hashing.

get.description:
Returns a list of LLM cost documents. Supports optional JSON filter, sorting and pagination. If explicit pagination (page/limit) is provided, response is wrapped with { success, data, meta }. Otherwise a raw array is returned.
Tenant scoping: When Authorization (Bearer JWT) is present, the tenant from the JWT is enforced and overrides any header/query values. If a different organization_id/tenant_id is provided than the JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403. Without JWT (demo/testing), x-organization-id header or query aliases (?tenant_id or ?organization_id) may be used to set scope. Any tenant fields in the filter are ignored server-side.
Debugging: Responses include an X-Applied-Tenant header indicating the resolved tenant filter.

parameters.name: x-organization-id
parameters.description: Tenant (organization) ID. Required when JWT is not provided; ignored if JWT is present with tenant. If provided and conflicts with JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Alias for tenant filter. Ignored when JWT is present. Header takes precedence over query. If conflicting with JWT tenant, 403 is returned.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Alias for tenant filter. Ignored when JWT is present. Header takes precedence over query. If conflicting with JWT tenant, 403 is returned.

get.description: Returns per-user total cost and total minutes for the specified tenant.

Aggregates distinct active users per tenant primarily from the session_tracking collection. Accepts optional time range and status filters. If includeInactive=true, falls back to the users collection joined with known tenants to include tenants without recent activity.

parameters.name: to

parameters.description: When true, includes tenants from tenants/users collections even if no activity is found.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users with optional JSON filtering and sorting. Tenant scoping: when Authorization is present, the tenant is taken from JWT (req.auth.tenantId) and overrides query/header. If a different organization_id/tenant_id is provided than the JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403. In demo mode without JWT, organization_id from header or query is allowed but is still enforced in filtering.

parameters.name: to

parameters.name: status
